content.title: 限制性定语从句·关系副词 when / where / why 速查
content.intro: 关系副词在从句中作状语(时间/地点/原因),等于「介词+which」。判断口诀:从句缺状语→用关系副词,缺主语/宾语→用关系代词 that/which。

headers: 用法 / 例句 / 等价
rows: 时间先行词(day/time/year):the day when = on/in which
地点先行词(place/country/room):the place where = in/at which
原因(reason):the reason why = for which
从句缺主宾、或表达更正式:on which / in which / by which

specialRules.rule: 从句只缺状语(时间/地点/原因)→ 才用关系副词
specialRules.mark: the day when I arrived(缺时间状语)

specialRules.rule: 从句缺主语/宾语 → 即使先行词是时间/地点也用 that/which
specialRules.mark: the day that changed my life(缺主语→that)

specialRules.rule: the day when = on/in which;the place where = in/at which;the reason why = for which
介词后只能用 which,不可用 that

why: 关系副词 = 介词 + which,在从句里充当状语,所以从句的主语、宾语都不缺;一旦主语或宾语缺了,就要换成关系代词 that/which。
gaokaoPoints: when/where/why 与 which/that 的判断(看从句缺什么成分);介词+which;语法填空高频。
the way 后的定语从句:用 that / in which / 或省略,但不用 which 单独引导。

examVsReal.exam: the house where I live（考试/书面）
examVsReal.note: 考试用 where;口语常省略关系词、把介词放句末

examVsReal.exam: the reason why he gave up（考试）
examVsReal.real: the reason he gave up / the reason that he gave up
examVsReal.note: 考试用 why;口语里 why 常被省略或用 that
